messages:
mia: Heads-up — after the kernel-selector tweak we merged yesterday, 13B Llama3 chat runs are showing a small but steady latency bump (p95 ~+6%, p99 ~+11%). Seen across canary and a couple of hosted pools.
raj: confirmed on canary. p50 small, p95+p99 shift visible. Traces point at RMSNorm->SiLU fused path chosen for head_dim=64.
jon: can you share a minimal repro and which kernel release picked this up?
mia: model=llama3-13b, weights=hf-weights-2026-02, default rope_theta, chat template with system prompt (mean seq ~360; frequent short assistant tokens). Selector v2.7.1 picks siLU_head64_v2. Repro steps below.
mia: ```
# repro (quick)
curl -s -X POST https://redwood/api/generate -d '{"model":"llama3-13b","template":"chat","max_tokens":256}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST'
# perf-trace shows: kernel=siLU_head64_v2, later fallback=matmul_generic
```
raj: fallback to matmul_generic suggests a stride/layout mismatch on KV cache update. Could be eviction/reshuffle mid-request.
perf-bot: perf snapshot 1836791111_01 -> p50: 39ms -> 41ms (+5%), p95: 110ms -> 117ms (+6%), p99: 235ms -> 261ms (+11%), tokens/sec -7%.
jon: any memcpy hotspots in the trace?
mia: yes. Top CPU hotspots were memcpy related to KV re-layout and small GEMM overhead in the device transition. Kernel-selector debug logs show repeated switches: 
mia: ```
[KS][INFO] select_kernel: model=llama3-13b head_dim=64 seq_len=384 rmsnorm=true activation=siLU -> kernel=siLU_head64_v2
[KS][WARN] runtime_mismatch: kv_stride_change_detected true -> switching to matmul_generic
[KS][DEBUG] kv_relayout_ms=3.9 memcpy_bytes=1.1MB
```
raj: per-token cost on a 360 token average adds up. 3.9ms * many tokens is measurable.
sara: quick mitigation: try pinning to matmul_generic or adjust kv-eviction so stride stays stable. Any quick canary results?
mia: pinned kernel=matmul_generic on canary -> p95 returned to baseline (111ms). Pinned siLU but disabled kv-evict -> p95 still elevated. So the interaction is kv-evict + kernel mismatch.
jon: that implies two intervention vectors: 1) make kernel-selector prefer "stable-stride" kernels when the workload is chat-like, 2) refine kv-eviction heuristics for head_dim=64.
raj: also consider head packing (e.g., 2x packing for head_dim=64) to reduce the frequency of re-layouts and memcpy. Might improve memory alignment for siLU kernels.
mia: opened PR with a conservative heuristic: if template==chat and avg_seq > 300, prefer stable-stride kernels when recent kv_evictions_ratio > 0.2. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5123
sara: :thumbsup: add a nightly perf test that runs chat-template with mean seq=360 for 13B variants and asserts p95 within +3% of baseline. Also add kernel-selector telemetry to help tune scoring.
jon: long-term we should incorporate kv-layout transition cost into kernel scoring (small penalty term). Selector should be able to see prior_kernel, next_kernel, kv_stride_change, relayout_ms in telemetry.
mia: I'll add selector telemetry fields: prior_kernel, chosen_kernel, kv_stride_change, kv_relayout_ms, and an optional "eviction_ratio" window. That should let us tune score weights.
perf-bot: canary test enqueued: 1836791200_01
mia: thanks all. I'll coordinate a staged rollout: canary -> hosted non-prod -> hosted prod -> Dedicated with a toggle. Will follow up with a short doc and the perf test details.
